52008.meaningLit: canonical text of the great section

52009.meaningLit: canonical text of connected discourses, the great section

52013.meaning1: name of a forest outside Vesālī

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ
atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭ'āgārasālā ten'upasaṅkami.

52014.meaning1: name of a forest outside Kapilavatthu
52014.commentary: (MNa) mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyan'ti mahāvanaṃ nāma sayaṃjātaṃ aropimaṃ saparicchedaṃ mahantaṃ vanaṃ. kapilavatthusāmantā pana mahāvanaṃ himavantena saha ek'ābaddhaṃ aparicchedaṃ hutvā mahāsamuddaṃ āhacca ṭhitaṃ. idaṃ tādisaṃ na hoti. saparicchedaṃ mahantaṃ vanan'ti mahāvanaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ mahāvane mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sabbeh'eva arahantehi
kapilavatthusmiṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena mahāvanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami divāvihārāya. mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā beluvalaṭṭhikāya mūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
vāḷamigasaṅghasevitaṃ, kuñjaramattakareṇuloḷitaṃ, asahāyikā gantum'icchasi, rahitaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ mahāvanaṃ.

52016.meaning1: great dense forest; enormous thicket of trees

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, mahācoro gahananissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro tiṇagahanaṃ vā nissito hoti, rukkhagahanaṃ vā rodhaṃ vā mahāvanasaṇḍaṃ vā.
middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.

52019.meaning1: great wind; strong gale; wind storm

examples.text: vāt'ātape visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya, agginā ḍahitvā masiṃ kareyya, masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā ophuṇeyya nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya.

52020.meaning1: large reservoir; big dam; large pond

52021.meaning1: incredibly disgusting thing; excrement, urine, ashes, and clay
52021.commentary: (VMVt) apakatibhesajjattā vikaṭāni virūpāni visaharaṇato mahāvisayattā mahantāni cā'ti mahāvikaṭāni. (KVt) cattāri mahāvikaṭānī'ti gūthaṃ, muttaṃ, chārikā, mattikā ca āsay'ādi-vasena virūpāni jātānī'ti katvā vikaṭānī'ti vā apakatibhojanattā vikaṭāni virūpāni jātānī'ti vā attho.

52022.meaning1: extremely perverse eating habit; unnatural way of eating

examples.text: yāvakīvañ'ca me, sāriputta, sakaṃ muttakarīsaṃ apariyādinnaṃ hoti, sakaṃ'y'eva sudaṃ muttakarīsaṃ āhāremi. idaṃsu me, sāriputta, mahāvikaṭabhojanasmiṃ hoti.

52023.meaning1: incredibly disgusting thing; excrement, urine, ashes, and clay
52023.commentary: (VMVt) apakatibhesajjattā vikaṭāni virūpāni visaharaṇato mahāvisayattā mahantāni cā'ti mahāvikaṭāni. (KVt) cattāri mahāvikaṭānī'ti gūthaṃ, muttaṃ, chārikā, mattikā ca āsay'ādi-vasena virūpāni jātānī'ti katvā vikaṭānī'ti vā apakatibhojanattā vikaṭāni virūpāni jātānī'ti vā attho.

examples.text: anāpatti udakadantapone, cattāri mahāvikatāni sati paccaye asati kappiyakārake sāmaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

52024.commentary: (DNa) mahāvijito'ti so kira sāgarapariyantaṃ mahantaṃ pathavīmaṇḍalaṃ vijini, iti mahantaṃ vijitam'assāti mahāvijito tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ agamāsi.

examples.text: bhagavā etadavoca, bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, rājā mahāvijito nāma ahosi aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo pahūtajātarūparajato pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇo pahūtadhanadhañño paripuṇṇakosakoṭṭh'āgāro.

52027.meaning1: that which is extremely hard to cross
52027.commentary: (DNa) mahāviduggā'ti mahāviduggaṃ nāma cattāro oghā. tato uddharitvā nibbānathale patiṭṭhapetvā.

examples.text: mahābandhanā mokkhaṃ karitvā caturāsītipāṇasahassāni mahāviduggā uddharitvā tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā sattatālaṃ vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā aññaṃ sattatālam'pi acciṃ abhinimminitvā pajjalitvā dhūmāyitvā mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ paccuṭṭhāsiṃ.

evam'eva kho, rājañña, yathārūpe yaññe gāvo vā haññanti, aj'eḷakā vā haññanti, kukkuṭasūkarā vā haññanti, vividhā vā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjanti, paṭiggāhakā ca honti micchādiṭṭhī micchāsaṅkappā micchāvācā micchākamm'antā micchāājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatī micchāsamādhī, evarūpo kho, rājañña, yañño na mahapphalo hoti na mah'ānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.

52030.meaning1: great analysis (of the monk's training rules)

52032.meaning1: name of king Mahāsudassana's peaked roof house
52032.meaning2: name of king Mahāsudassana's peaked roof house

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, rājā mahāsudassano mahāviyūhā kūṭ'āgārā nikkhamitvā sovaṇṇamayaṃ kūṭ'āgāraṃ pavisitvā rūpiyamaye pallaṅke nisinno mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihāsi.

52033.meaning1: headed by Mahāviyūha, the peaked roof building
52033.meaning2: headed by Mahāviyūha, the peaked roof building

examples.text: rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa… caturāsīti kūṭ'āgārasahassāni ahesuṃ mahāviyūha-kūṭ'āgāra-ppamukhāni

tasmiṃ samaye satthā pavattitavaradhammacakko anupubben'āgantvā anāthapiṇḍikena mahāseṭṭhinā catupaṇṇāsakoṭidhanaṃ vissajjetvā kārite jetavanamahāvihāre viharati mahājanaṃ saggamagge ca mokkhamagge ca patiṭṭhāpayamāno.

52038.meaning1: great hero; epithet of the Buddha

examples.text: tassa te nāga nāgassa, mahāvīrassa bhāsato, sabbe dev'ānumodanti, ubho nāradapabbatā.
evam'etaṃ mahāvīra, yathā samaṇa bhāsasi, ettha c'eke visīdanti, paṅkamhi'va jaraggavo.

52040.commentary: (DNa) na kevalañ'ca idh'eva evaṃ dassesi, mahāsatipaṭṭhāne, majjhimanikāyamhi satipaṭṭhāne, cūḷataṇhāsaṅkhaye, mahātaṇhāsaṅkhaye, cūḷavedallasutte, mahāvedallasutte, raṭṭhapālasutte, māgaṇḍiyasutte, dhātuvibhaṅge, āneñjasappāye, sakale vedanāsaṃyutte'ti evaṃ anekesu sutt'antesu paṭhamaṃ rūpakammaṭṭhānaṃ kathetvā pacchā arūpakammaṭṭhānaṃ vedanāvasena nivattetvā dassesi.

examples.text: cūḷavedalla-mahāvedalla-sammādiṭṭhi-sakkapañha-saṅkhārabhājaniya-mahāpuṇṇama-sutt'ādayo sabbe'pi vedañ'ca tuṭṭhiñ'ca laddhā laddhā pucchitasutt'antā vedallan'ti veditabbaṃ. evaṃ aṅgavasena navavidhaṃ.

52042.meaningLit: longer discourse on the simile of the elephant's footprint

52043.meaning1: laughing out loud; roar of laughter

examples.text: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū mahāhasitaṃ hasantā antaraghare gacchanti
sakasakamhi bhavane, nisīditvāna devatā, hasanti tā mahāhasitaṃ, disvān'accherakaṃ nabhe.
mahikā, bhikkhave, candimasūriyānaṃ upakkilesā, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.

52047.meaning1: greedy; of many wishes; full of desire

examples.text: app'icchass'āyaṃ dhammo n'āyaṃ dhammo mah'icchassa
so mah'iccho samāno vighātavā asantuṭṭho itarītara-cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārena pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati anavaññappaṭilābhāya lābha-sakkāra-siloka-ppaṭilābhāya
mah'icchatāya saṃvattanti no app'icchatāya
cirassaṃ vata me mahito mah'esī, mahāvanaṃ samaṇo paccapādi, so'haṃ cajissāmi sahassapāpaṃ, sutvāna gāthaṃ tava dhammayuttaṃ.

52050.meaning1: appearance of one hundred senior women

examples.text: atha kho taṇhā ca … mah'itthivaṇṇasataṃ abhinimmineyyāmā'ti. atha kho taṇhā ca … mah'itthivaṇṇasataṃ abhinimminitvā yena bhagavā … anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto.

ye dhammā abrāhmaṇakārakā te dhamme samādāya vattamānā evam'āhaṃsu, indam'avhayāma, somam'avhayāma, varuṇam'avhayāma, īsānam'avhayāma, pajāpatim'avhayāma, brahmam'avhayāma, mahiddhim'avhayāma, yamam'avhayāmā'ti.

52054.meaning1: of great supernormal power; magically powerful

examples.text: imesaṃ ce tumhe, bhikkhave, dasannaṃ kathāvatthūnaṃ upādāy'upādāya kathaṃ katheyyātha, imesam'pi candimasūriyānaṃ evaṃ mah'iddhikānaṃ evaṃ mah'ānubhāvānaṃ tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyeyyātha, ko pana vādo aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānan'ti!
suddh'odano mahārājā, gotamī ca pajāpatī, abhiññātā mahātherā, theriyo ca mah'iddhikā.

52055.meaning1: of greater supernormal power; more magically powerful
52055.construction:
mahā + iddhi + ka + tara
mahiddhika + tara

examples.text: passāmi kho ty'āhaṃ, mārisa, evarūpaṃ iddh'ānubhāvan'ti. tayā ca kho, mārisa, mayā ca sv'eva bhagavā mah'iddhikataro c'eva mah'ānubhāvataro ca. gaccheyyāsi tvaṃ, mārisa, tassa bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassā'ti?

52056.construction:
mahā + iddhi + ka + tā
mahiddhika + tā

examples.text: samaṇassa gotamassa mah'iddhikatā mah'ānubhāvatā, na ca vata no ito pubbe diṭṭho vā, suto vā, añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ mah'iddhiko evaṃ mah'ānubhāvo yath'āyaṃ samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito
atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho, tathāgatassa mah'iddhikatā mah'ānubhāvatā!

52057.meaning1: great Inda; lord of the gods

examples.text: nanu ahaṃ citta tay'āmhi yācito, giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅ'gamā, mahindaghosatthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

52058.synonym: jagatiruha, taru, duma, pādapa, rukkha, viṭapī

examples.text: mahiñ'ca pana ṭhito anonamanto, phusati karehi ubhohi jaṇṇukāni, mahiruhaparimaṇḍalo ahosi, sucaritakammavipākasesakena.

52059.meaning1: having the circumference of a tree

examples.text: mahiñ'ca pana ṭhito anonamanto, phusati karehi ubhohi jaṇṇukāni, mahiruhaparimaṇḍalo ahosi, sucaritakammavipākasesakena.
dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, mahisānaṃ sataṃ mahiṃsabhūtānaṃ sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ passannaṃ paggharitaṃ..

52062.meaning2: name of a country, present Mysore

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ… hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahisayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vaṭṭakayuddhaṃ daṇḍayuddhaṃ muṭṭhiyuddhaṃ nibbuddhaṃ uyyodhikaṃ balaggaṃ senābyūhaṃ anīkadassanaṃ iti vā iti evarūpā visūkadassanā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… assalakkhaṇaṃ mahisalakkhaṇaṃ usabhalakkhaṇaṃ golakkhaṇaṃ ajalakkhaṇaṃ meṇḍalakkhaṇaṃ kukkuṭalakkhaṇaṃ vaṭṭakalakkhaṇaṃ godhālakkhaṇaṃ kaṇṇikālakkhaṇaṃ kacchapalakkhaṇaṃ migalakkhaṇaṃ

52065.commentary: (VINa) gosappī'tiādīhi loke pākaṭaṃ dassetvā yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappatī'ti iminā aññesam'pi migarohitasas'ādīnaṃ sappiṃ saṅgahetvā dassesi. yesañ'hi khīraṃ atthi, sappi'pi tesaṃ atthi'y'eva, taṃ pana sulabhaṃ vā hotu dullabhaṃ vā, asammoh'atthaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: uggaputtā mah'issāsā, sikkhitā daḷhadhammino, samantā parikireyyuṃ, sahassaṃ apalāyinaṃ.
atikāyo mah'issāso, ajjuno kekak'ādhipo, sahassabāhu ucchinno, isim'āsajja gotamaṃ.
sappi nāma gosappi vā ajikāsappi vā mahiṃsasappi vā yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappati tesaṃ sappi.
catuppadānan'ti sīhā byagghā dīpi acchā taracchā kokā mahiṃsā hatthī.
khīraṃ nāma gokhīraṃ vā ajikākhīraṃ vā mahiṃsakhīraṃ vā, yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappati, tesaṃ khīraṃ.

dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, mahiṃsānaṃ sataṃ mahiṃsabhūtānaṃ sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ passannaṃ paggharitaṃ … dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, urabbhānaṃ sataṃ urabbhabhūtānaṃ … ajānaṃ sataṃ ajabhūtānaṃ… migānaṃ sataṃ migabhūtānaṃ… kukkuṭānaṃ sataṃ kukkuṭabhūtānaṃ… sūkarānaṃ sataṃ sūkarabhūtānaṃ…

seyyath'idaṃ… hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vaṭṭakayuddhaṃ daṇḍayuddhaṃ muṭṭhiyuddhaṃ nibbuddhaṃ uyyodhikaṃ bal'aggaṃ senābyūhaṃ anīkadassanaṃ iti vā iti evarūpā visūkadassanā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… hatthilakkhaṇaṃ assalakkhaṇaṃ mahiṃsalakkhaṇaṃ usabhalakkhaṇaṃ golakkhaṇaṃ ajalakkhaṇaṃ meṇḍalakkhaṇaṃ kukkuṭalakkhaṇaṃ vaṭṭakalakkhaṇaṃ godhālakkhaṇaṃ

52075.commentary: (VINa) gosappī'tiādīhi loke pākaṭaṃ dassetvā yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappatī'ti iminā aññesam'pi migarohitasas'ādīnaṃ sappiṃ saṅgahetvā dassesi. yesañ'hi khīraṃ atthi, sappi'pi tesaṃ atthi'y'eva, taṃ pana sulabhaṃ vā hotu dullabhaṃ vā, asammoh'atthaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: sappi nāma gosappi vā ajikāsappi vā mahiṃsasappi vā yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappati tesaṃ sappi.

yathā, mahārāja, mahiyā rājaputtānaṃ hatthi-assaratha-dhanu-tharu-lekha-muddā-sikkhā-khagga-manta-suti-sammuti-yuddha-yujjhāpana-kiriyā karaṇīyā, avasesānaṃ puthu-vessa-suddānaṃ kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā karaṇīyā

52077.meaning1: name of a river; one of the five great rivers of ancient India

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyath'idaṃ gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī, tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddo'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti
pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

52078.grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from mahanta

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yam'idaṃ, bho gotama, dāne puññañ'ca puññamahī ca taṃ dāyakānaṃ sukhāya hotū'ti.

52081.meaning1: lord of the earth; king; ruler

examples.text: idha ca mahīpatissa kāmabhogī, gihipatirūpakā bahū bhavanti, yadi ca jahati sabbakāmabhogaṃ, labhati anuttaraṃ uttamadhan'aggan'ti.
kusāvatimhi nagare, yadā āsiṃ mahīpati, mahāsudassano nāma, cakkavattī mahabbalo.

52083.commentary: (VVa) antalikkhe mahīyatī'ti ākāse ṭhatvā ākāsaṭṭhen'eva mahatā parivārena pūjīyati.

examples.text: ekā'hi dāṭhā tidivehi pūjitā, ekā pana gandhārapure mahīyati, kāliṅgarañño vijite pun'ekaṃ, ekaṃ pana nāgarājā maheti.
ko nu dibbena yānena, sabbasetena hatthinā, turiyatāḷitanigghoso, antalikkhe mahīyati.

52084.synonym: jagatiruha, taru, duma, pādapa, rukkha, viṭapī
52084.commentary: (JAa) mahiyā mahīruhe'ti mahiruho vuccati rukkho, tasmiṃ imissā mahiyā jāte rukkhe'ti attho.

examples.text: khemaṃ yahiṃ tattha arī udīrito, dakassa majjhe jalate ghat'āsano, na ajja vāso mahiyā mahīruhe, disā bhajavho saraṇ'ājja no bhayan'ti.
ekā'hi dāṭhā tidivehi pūjitā, ekā pana gandhārapure mahīyati, kāliṅgarañño vijite pun'ekaṃ, ekaṃ pana nāgarājā maheti.

52086.meaning1: renowned; of great influence; distinguished; important; (comm) with large retinues
52086.construction: mahā + yasas + ka mahāyasas > mahesas + ka
52086.notes: CPD also suggests mahā + īsa + ākhya

examples.text: api ca te ahaṃ, brahme, gatiñ'ca pajānāmi, jutiñ'ca pajānāmi, evaṃ mah'iddhiko bako brahmā, evaṃ mah'ānubhāvo bako brahmā, evaṃ mahesakkho bako brahmā'ti.
na kho, bhikkhu, sukaro so bhagavā amhehi upasaṅkamituṃ, aññāhi mahesakkhāhi devatāhi parivuto.

52087.construction:
mahā + yasas + ka + tara
mahesakkha + tara
52087.notes: CPD also suggests mahā + īsa + ākhya

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno, so dīgh'āyukataro ca hoti vaṇṇavantataro ca mahesakkhataro ca. ye pana te sattā pacchā upapannā, te app'āyukatarā ca honti dubbaṇṇatarā ca appesakkhatarā ca.

52088.meaning1: fact of being of great influence
52088.construction:
mahā + yasas + ka + tta
mahesakkha + tta

examples.text: appesakkhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā appesakkhattaṃ upaneti, mahesakkhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahesakkhattaṃ upaneti, app'abhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā appabhogattaṃ upaneti, mahābhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahābhogattaṃ upaneti

52089.meaning1: leading to being of great influence; conducive to importance

examples.text: no ce kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati, sace manussattaṃ āgacchati yattha yattha paccājāyati mahesakkho hoti. mahesakkhasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, anissāmanako hoti, paralābha-sakkāra-garukāra-mānana-vandana-pūjanāsu na issati na upadussati na issaṃ bandhati.
mahesayaṃ avantīnaṃ, sovīrānañ'ca rorukaṃ, mithilā ca videhānaṃ, campā aṅgesu māpitā, bārāṇasī ca kāsīnaṃ, ete govindamāpitā'ti.

52091.meaning1: great sage; mighty seer; epithet of the Buddha

examples.text: yadatthi saṅgataṃ kiñci, bhavo vā yattha labbhati, sabbaṃ anissaraṃ etaṃ, iti vuttaṃ mah'esinā.
aññena ca kevalinaṃ mah'esiṃ, khīṇ'āsavaṃ kukkuccavūpasantaṃ, annena pānena upaṭṭhahassu, khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī'ti.

52092.meaning2: great female sage; mighty female seer

examples.text: aniggataratanake'ti mah'esī sayanigharā anikkhantā hoti, ubho vā anikkhantā honti.

so puratthimena nagarassa navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ kārāpetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā khar'ājinaṃ nivāsetvā sappitelena kāyaṃ abbhañjitvā magavisāṇena piṭṭhiṃ kaṇḍuvamāno navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ pavisati, saddhiṃ mahesiyā brāhmaṇena ca purohitena.
aj'eḷakā ca gāvo ca, vividhā yattha haññare, na taṃ sammaggatā yaññaṃ, upayanti mah'esino.
cirassaṃ vata me mahito mah'esī, mahāvanaṃ samaṇo paccapādi, so'haṃ cajissāmi sahassapāpaṃ, sutvāna gāthaṃ tava dhammayuttaṃ.
cirassaṃ vata me mahito mah'esī, mahāvanaṃ samaṇo paccapādi, so'haṃ cajissāmi sahassapāpaṃ, sutvāna gāthaṃ tava dhammayuttaṃ.
pupphāni h'eva pacinantaṃ, byāsattamanasaṃ naraṃ, suttaṃ gāmaṃ mah'ogho'va, maccu ādāya gacchati.
gedhaṃ brūmi mah'ogho'ti, ājavaṃ brūmi jappanaṃ, ārammaṇaṃ pakappanaṃ, kāmapaṅko duraccayo.
taṃ nadīhi vijānātha, sobbhesu padaresu ca, saṇantā yanti kusobbhā, tuṇhīyanti mah'odadhī.
mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.

52098.meaning1: with a big belly; having a fat stomach
52098.commentary: (PYt) mahodaro'ti mahāudaro. (MNt) mahodaro'ti vipulakucchi. yebhuyyena hi lakuṇṭakā sattā rassagīvā puthulakucchikā'va hontī'ti tathā vuttaṃ.
